text: State True or False: In Python, data type of 74 is same as the data type of 74.0. (2026 Board)
explanation: 74 is an int and 74.0 is a float; Python treats whole numbers without a decimal point as int and numbers with a decimal point as float, so their data types differ.
whyWrong: Incorrect: type(74) is int while type(74.0) is float, so they are not the same type.

text: Which of the following statements is true about dictionaries in Python? (2026 Board)
options: A dictionary is an example of sequence datatype.
A dictionary cannot have two elements with same key.
A dictionary cannot have two elements with same value.
The key and value of an element cannot be the same.

whyWrong: Dictionaries are mapping types, not sequence types like lists/tuples/strings.

subject: Computer Science
text: State whether the following statement is True or False: In Python, Logical errors can be handled using try...except...finally statement. (2026 Board)
explanation: try...except...finally only catches runtime exceptions (things Python detects and raises, like ZeroDivisionError). A logical error produces a wrong but syntactically valid result without raising any exception, so it cannot be caught or handled by exception handling.
whyWrong: Logical errors do not raise exceptions at all -- the program runs and produces an incorrect result silently, so try...except...finally has nothing to catch.

text: A table has two candidate keys, one of which is chosen as the primary key. How many alternate keys does this table have? (2026 Board)
explanation: Alternate keys are the candidate keys that were NOT chosen as the primary key. With 2 candidate keys and 1 chosen as primary key, exactly 1 remains as an alternate key.
whyWrong: This would mean every candidate key became the primary key, which is impossible since only one key can be primary.
There are only 2 candidate keys total, so at most 1 can remain after removing the primary key.
There are only 2 candidate keys total, so 3 alternate keys is not possible.

text: Which of the following SQL command can change the degree of the existing relation? (2026 Board)
explanation: Degree = number of columns (attributes) in a relation. ALTER TABLE is used to add or remove columns, which changes the degree. DROP TABLE removes the whole table; UPDATE and DELETE affect rows/data, not the column structure.
whyWrong: DROP TABLE removes the entire table; it does not modify the structure of an existing table.
UPDATE...SET changes column values in existing rows; it does not add or remove columns.
DELETE removes rows (cardinality), not columns, so it does not change the degree.
